title: 第二百二十四章 残酷的战场第二百二十三章 下马威
lines: 第二百二十四章残酷的战场
风遁螺旋手里剑被掷出，那在空中飞行的查克拉球在高速的转动，所及之处空气震荡。
“竟将如此高密度高转速的查克拉掷了出去！”水门不禁惊讶的说道。
精神力达到了夜天云如今的境地，同时控制风属性的性质变化与形态变化虽然耗费心力，但也不是触手不可及之事。
而且，以夜天云如今的RouTi、细胞与经脉的强度和他那海量的精神力，将螺旋手里剑如原著那般掷出也并非难事。
可见，夜天云如今的身体素质已经是超人级别。
“那是什么忍术！！”
“管他娘的什么忍术，快闪开！！”
看着高速飞来的螺旋手里剑，众位沙忍惊慌失措，他们未曾料到会有如此奇异的远程攻击，速度奇快，至于威力众位沙忍虽不清楚，但暗影幽蝶认真释放的忍术的威力难道会弱么？
但螺旋手里剑可不等人，几息过后便飞进了沙忍的大部队之中，锋锐的风属性查克拉四角翼将沿途将所及之处的沙忍切成了两半。
断臂残骸，血染大地。
众位沙忍惊恐之下逃窜的速度更快，他们向两侧逃窜，准备让出一条路来让夜天云的忍术径直通过。
而看着正向两侧逃窜的沙忍，夜天云的嘴角勾出一抹弧度，那一抹代表着危险的弧度。
“是时候扩张了吧。”夜天云轻声说道。
话音刚落，飞到了沙忍部队中央的螺旋手里剑猛然扩大了数倍，所及之处又将大批的沙忍切成了两半。
接着在众位沙忍惊恐的目光中。。
“嘣。”的剧烈爆炸声响起。
那螺旋手里剑猛然爆炸，一个巨大的银色能量球随着爆炸声而出现。
那巨大的能量球高速转动，将地面完全割裂。
众位沙忍的惨叫声虽然尖厉，但那巨大能量球中传来的声音更是刺耳无比，那一声声凄厉的惨叫声最终被风属性查克拉的切割声覆盖。
众位沙忍看着那巨大的能量球目瞪口呆，眼中闪过了浓浓的惊惧之色，同时也有着愤怒。
这一击，好多的同伴都处于攻击范围内。
同样惊诧的还有木叶的忍者，这是他们第一次亲眼得见暗影幽蝶的强大实力，不由得万分惊讶，不过接下来便被浓浓的欣喜与战意取代。
他们认为有着夜天云坐镇，这场战争绝对能够取胜。
那银白色的能量球终于消失了，可是被击中的所有忍者全部消失了。
坑底的沙石已经变成了暗红色，显然是处于攻击范围内的沙忍被绞杀成了碎末，鲜血渗入到土壤之中。
这一击，让上百名沙忍全部阵亡，另外还有数十位沙忍被波及受伤。
夜天云的这一击将沙忍的气势打击到了低谷，而看着依旧有些惊慌失措的沙忍，夜天云朗声道：“进攻吧！”
content_en:
Chapter 224 The cruel battlefield
The Wind Release Spiral Shuriken was thrown, and the chakra ball flying in the air was rotating at a high speed, and the air where it touched vibrated.
"He actually threw such high-density and high-speed chakra!" Minato couldn't help but said in surprise.
The mental power has reached Ye Tianyun's current level. Although it takes a lot of effort to control the nature and form changes of the wind attribute, it is not out of reach.
Moreover, with Ye Tianyun's current strength of flesh, cells and meridians and his massive mental power, it is not difficult to throw the spiral shuriken like in the original work.
It can be seen that Ye Tianyun's current physical fitness is already at superhuman level.
"What kind of ninjutsu is that!!"
"What the hell ninjutsu, get out of the way!!"
"Quickly retreat!!"
Seeing the spiral shuriken flying at high speed, all the sand ninjas panicked. They had never expected such a strange long-range attack, which was extremely fast. As for the power, the sand ninjas were not sure about it, but could the power of the ninjutsu released by Shadow Butterfly be weak?
But the Rasen Shuriken didn't wait for anyone. After a few breaths, it flew into the large army of sand ninjas. Its sharp wind-attributed chakra quadrilateral wings cut the sand ninjas in its path in half.
Broken arms and remains, blood stained the ground.
The sand ninjas fled faster in fear. They fled to both sides, preparing to make a way for Ye Tianyun's ninjutsu to pass directly.
Looking at the sand ninjas who were fleeing to both sides, Ye Tianyun's mouth curved, and that curve represented danger.
"It's time to expand." Ye Tianyun said softly.
As soon as he finished speaking, the spiral shuriken that flew to the center of the sand ninja army suddenly expanded several times, and cut a large number of sand ninjas in half wherever it touched.
Then in the horrified eyes of all the sand ninjas. .
"Boom." A violent explosion sounded.
The spiral shuriken suddenly exploded, and a huge silver energy ball appeared with the explosion.
The huge energy ball rotated at high speed, completely splitting the ground.
Although the screams of the sand ninjas were shrill, the sound coming from the huge energy ball was even more harsh. The shrill screams were eventually covered by the cutting sound of wind attribute chakra.
The sand ninjas were dumbfounded when they looked at the huge energy ball, with deep fear and anger flashing in their eyes.
With this blow, many companions were within the attack range.
Also surprised were the ninjas of Konoha. This was the first time they saw the powerful strength of Shadow Butterfly with their own eyes. They couldn't help but be extremely surprised, but then they were replaced by strong joy and fighting spirit.
They believe that with Ye Tianyun in charge, this war can definitely be won.
The silver-white energy ball finally disappeared, but all the ninjas that were hit disappeared.
The sand at the bottom of the pit has turned dark red. Apparently, the sand ninjas within the attack range were strangled to pieces, and their blood seeped into the soil.
This blow killed hundreds of sand ninjas, and dozens more were injured.
Ye Tianyun's blow knocked the Sha Ninja's momentum to the lowest point, and looking at the Sand Ninja who was still a little panicked, Ye Tianyun said loudly: "Attack!"
